quest.title: Seirai Stormchasers: Part IV
quest.description: After arriving on Seirai island, you meet two adventurers who are currently investigating something known as a Warding Stone. But following the footprints of a cat, you arrive at a dilapidated shrine, in which sits a cat named "Neko," who proclaims itself to be the "provisional head priestess of the Asase Shrine." After you help "Neko" repair the shrine's Offering Box, it reveals the method of sealing the Warding Stones to you. Additionally, you learn that should you be able to seal all four Warding Stones throughout Seirai Island, you can calm the thunderstorm that enshrouds it.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Hero's Wit x2

talks.objective: Go to the Warding Stone's location

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: It seems like all four Warding Stones have been sealed.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: I—It's you! How did you get up there?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Taisuke said that you passed through some kind of door — and then you disappeared.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: What on earth is with that door? How strange...

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Etsuko and I heard a sudden rumbling from above, almost like thunder.

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: But the storm should have abated already...

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Rocks floating in the sky... formed a platform...

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Huh. That's... I must confess that I've never heard of such a natural phenomenon occurring on Seirai Island...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: ...Which part of that sounds like a natural phenomenon, seriously...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: It's super unnatural no matter how you look at it.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Well, natural or otherwise, the storm over Seirai Island has been calmed, and our commission is complete...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You know, we also found this strange feather...

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: This is... Taisuke, you have a look.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Apologies, but I have no idea where this feather came from.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: This feather's pattern and texture are nothing like any birds I know of.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: And if you study its dimensions and the ratios involved, this bird would have been as large as that stone platform up there in the sky.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Is this feather that important? If you want to figure its history out, why don't you put up a commission at the Guild? Who knows, you might run into someone who can give you a lead.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Well, in that case, thanks again for your help, Adventurer. Taisuke and I will head back to the Guild to make our reports.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Ah, right. This is for you. It's not much... But I'd say you're still owed some payment for your help.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Taisuke, get ready to pack it up. We're headed back to the Guild.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Uh, so, Etsuko... Let's drop by that shrine real quick and see Lady Neko, shall we?

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Come on! It's a cat that can talk! A talking cat!

choices.text: I'll give it some thought myself...
You'd be right to say so.

talks.objective: Report back to Taisuke and Etsuko
